title: maya-thompson-soc2-evidence-scratchpad
content:
Daily SOC2 scratchpad - Maya T.

Quick context: personal task list for collecting AICPA evidence, coordinating vendor responses, and small policy TODOs. Mostly notes to self - not a finalized tracker.

TODAY (2026-02-25)
- Morning: sent follow-up to vendor-security@acme-vendor.com re: encrypt-at-rest certs (asked for KMS configuration screenshots). (todo: add to evidence bucket once received).
- Check: confirm backup retention policy doc exists for DB cluster (link in Confluence: CONFLUENCE-SEC-4321). If missing, request from infra-ops (Liam).
- Prep for quick sync w/ Priya at 11:30am: go over gap list for CC6 and CC7 controls.

TOP PRIORITIES (this week)
1) Gather encryption evidence for 3rd-party analytic vendor (Acme) - due 2026-03-02 to audit team. Steps:
   - ask for KMS config screenshot (sent) (owner: Maya) - awaiting reply
   - request their SOC2 report (if available) or datasheet (owner: Maya) - Jira: JIRA-SOC2-118
   - map their control IDs to our vendor risk matrix (owner: Priya)
2) Finalize access review logs for platform-admins (monthly) - collect from SSO/risky access tool and export audit CSV (owner: Liam).
3) Policy TODOs: update Data Retention policy to include embeddings retention clause (drafted below). Target for legal review: 2026-03-05.

SMALL ITEMS / NOTES TO SELF
- Evidence bucket folder: gs://redwood-soc2-evidence/2026/q1 (create subfolder acme-vendor when docs arrive).
- Reminder: annotate each evidence file with evidence-id format: SOC2-2026-Q1-<control>-<vendor|internal>-<date> (helps auditor cross-reference).
- Quick checklist for any vendor SOC2 report received: 1) scope check (systems covered), 2) period covered, 3) bridge letter? 4) auditor firm name, 5) any exceptions or carve-outs.

OPEN QUESTIONS / BLOCKERS
- Acme vendor replied saying they rotate KMS keys monthly - need config screenshots showing rotation policy (is rotation automated or manual?). If automated, ask for IAM role used.
- Does Dedicated infra have separate keyspace for Dedicated customers? If yes, need architecture diagram to show separation. (Action: ask infra-ops - Liam).

DRAFT LANGUAGE (Data Retention policy - embeddings clause)
"Redwood retains customer-generated embeddings and derived metadata only as necessary to provide the service and for the retention period specified in customer contract. Default retention for embeddings created via the hosted API is 90 days unless customer opts into extended retention. All retention and deletion operations are logged and subject to regular access reviews."

MEETINGS / FOLLOW-UPS
- 2026-02-26 09:00 sync with Priya (review vendor mapping) - prepare list of controls likely impacted by Acme's scope.
- 2026-03-03 internal evidence dry-run with audit team - bring complete folder for CC6/CC7 evidence.

LINKS / REFERENCES (personal quick links)
- Confluence: CONFLUENCE-SEC-4321 (SOC2 evidence index)
- Jira: JIRA-SOC2-118 (Acme vendor onboarding)
- Slack: #sec-soc2 thread (search: "Acme vendor certs")
- GH PR: github.com/redwood-inference/prs/842 (policy update for Data Retention)

ONE-LINERS TO SAVE INTO TICKET COMMENTS
- "Waiting on vendor screenshots for KMS config; requested rotation policy and IAM role details. Will upload to evidence bucket once received."
- "Draft retention clause added to PR 842; pinging legal for review (target 2026-03-05)."

END NOTES (informal)
- If I don't hear back from Acme by EOD Friday (2026-02-28) escalate to vendor ops.
- Keep evidence uploads tidy - auditors hate random filenames. Use the evidence-id convention above.

-- Maya
